recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. The current AllergyIntolerance guidance already reflects the FHIR-7550 and FHIR-26410 decisions; this reconciliation fixes the remaining stale List.emptyReason code/system that implementers could otherwise copy from the page.
issue_request: FHIR-7055 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 AllergyIntolerance. It asked that reporting No Known Allergies add a List resource reference and that the Negating Allergies and Intolerances section accepted for FHIR-7550 explain where List fits.
initial_application: The seed appears to have been applied by commit 0eea1114d50dfb349fa07d20c74b64aba76bb94c, whose message explicitly references #7055/#7550 and adds AllergyIntolerance negation usage notes. The current source retains the requested guidance: not-asked uses List.emptyReason=notasked, full-list none-known may use List.emptyReason, and AllergyIntolerance.code is generally preferred for No Known Allergies.
additional_context: FHIR-7550 established the broader explicit AllergyIntolerance negation section. FHIR-11101 recorded support for the CodeableConcept/AllergyIntolerance.code approach. FHIR-26410 later clarified that the preferred code is AllergyIntolerance.code and added an inline NKA example. Current List source binds emptyReason through http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/list-empty-reason to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/list-empty-reason and examples use code nilknown, while the AllergyIntolerance prose example and List notes still used the obsolete special-values/nil-known form.
reconciliation: Updated source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-notes.xml so the discouraged List.emptyReason NKA example uses http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/list-empty-reason with code nilknown. Updated source/list/list-notes.xml so the active List Empty Reason notes name nilknown rather than nil-known.
source_changes: source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-notes.xml: changed the List.emptyReason example coding system from http://hl7.org/fhir/special-values to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/list-empty-reason and the code from nil-known to nilknown.
source/list/list-notes.xml: changed the prose references to the List empty-reason code from nil-known to nilknown.
